summary: Use current live thread summaries across TUI, web and iOS

replay.detail: Stored thread history and existing pairing readers are preserved.

schema.detail: This client cleanup adds no storage or wire format.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or replication rules change.

compatibility.detail: Thread clients now require the current exact summary feed. Embedded and standalone views subscribe to the same authoritative title, lifecycle and unread updates. Older endpoints show the existing upgrade feedback instead of inferring summary changes from timeline events; bounded HTTP continuation pages remain supported.

downtime.detail: Client updates do not interrupt the daemon.

manual.detail: Upgrade TUI, web and iOS clients together before enabling thread writes. Existing history and pairings stay in place.

recovery.detail: Use a current client with the existing data and pairing. No data reset is required.
